android.desc:
AdMob Dashboard and AdMob earnings app for your phone.
Check yesterday's AdMob earnings without opening the AdMob console. AdDeck connects your AdMob account (and AdSense) and shows every app's revenue on one AdMob dashboard.

No server — your data stays on your phone.

ADMOB DASHBOARD
Your AdMob account at a glance.
- Today, yesterday and this month's AdMob earnings, with day-over-day change
- AdMob and AdSense added up, plus Unity, AppLovin, Meta and more via AdMob mediation
- Trend sparkline and per-network breakdown

ADMOB EARNINGS BY APP
See which app earns and which app drops.
- Your apps ranked by today's AdMob revenue
- Day-over-day change for each app, side by side
- Tap an app to open its own dashboard: revenue, last 7 days, eCPM, CTR and match rate

ADMOB ANALYTICS
Slice your AdMob reports any way you need.
- Period: 7 / 30 / 90 days or custom
- Dimension: app, country, format, platform, ad network
- Metric: revenue, impressions, clicks, eCPM, match rate, CTR, show rate
- Trend lines, bars, donut charts and tables

ADMOB AD UNIT REVENUE
- Revenue per ad unit (banner, native and more) for each app, with requests and match rate
- Last month, this year and all time, each compared with the previous period

ADMOB PAYMENTS AND ADSENSE
- Unpaid balance and the AdSense payment threshold as a progress bar, with the month you are likely to reach it
- Pick one app and the whole home screen follows that app

ADMOB EARNINGS WIDGET AND ALERTS
- 3 home screen widgets: today, summary and by app
- A morning "yesterday's AdMob earnings" notification
- An alert when revenue moves sharply against the 7-day average
- Pull to refresh

MADE FOR ADMOB PUBLISHERS
- An in-app glossary explains eCPM, match rate, show rate and mediation
- Light and dark themes, English and Korean
- For solo and small developers, indie game and app makers earning with Google AdMob or AdSense

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No server. Your Google tokens and AdMob data stay on your device.
- Read-only access. AdDeck only views your earnings and never changes your AdMob account.

PLEASE NOTE
- Figures are estimates from the AdMob and AdSense reporting APIs and may differ from final payments.
- AdDeck is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google, AdMob, or AdSense.
- Contains ads.

ACCESS
- Internet / network state, to fetch your revenue data
- Google account (read-only), to read your AdMob and AdSense reports.
